elements.text: Map app for Open and Navigate
Automatic (Amap in China, Google Maps elsewhere)
Amap only covers China, so Google Maps is used anywhere else. The Open and Navigate icons share the place's coordinates with the map app, only when you tap one. Saved in this browser only.
Hours above this limit are shown in red in the weather card. Saved in this browser only.
Show the dashboard when the app starts
Off keeps it tucked behind the ^ tab at the bottom of the map.
A trip groups markers. A waypoint's distance to accommodation or a home point only looks within its own trip. Your Home marker belongs to no trip.
No trips yet. Create one, then choose it for new markers or tag existing ones.
(same as the start for one day)
Ask any AI assistant to turn your itinerary into markers: copy the prompt, add your itinerary after it, then paste the answer here. You see a preview first, and nothing is added until you confirm.
Tap to choose a type and place it on the map
locks the map; press and hold a pin, then drag
Show all Side Quests on the map
off: a Side Quest shows only while its main stop is open
Open details when I click a marker
off: a click only selects it and shows its links
Press and hold a place for 1 second, then drag it to another day or stop. Alt + ↑ / ↓ moves it from the keyboard.
No markers yet. Choose a type above, then tap Place on map.
Everything here is off or minimal by default. Your markers, notes and settings stay in this browser. These switches only control what is sent to Open-Meteo.com for weather and elevation.
Shows the next 5 hours in each marker window. Sent when you place a marker and when the page loads (at most every 30 minutes).
Rounded to about 1 km. The forecast is the same, because its grid is 10 to 25 km. Recommended.
About 10 m. Shares the exact spot for no gain in forecast accuracy.
This applies to the "Show weather here" button as well.
Shown in marker windows and when you check a point. Always sends the exact location (about 10 m), whatever the weather setting: at 1 km the ground can differ by hundreds of metres in the mountains.
Look up places by name when importing

For itineraries from an AI: a place that came without coordinates is searched by its name or address. Those names are sent to Photon (Komoot), or Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) if Photon fails, only when you press Add on an import. Looked-up places are marked unverified.
Centre the map on me when the app opens

The browser asks for your location when the app opens. If you allow it for this site, the map opens on where you are; if you do not, it opens where you left off. Your position is only used on this device and is never sent anywhere.

When you are signed in and someone in a trip's party, or a friend, is online, your location is shared with them without switching anything on, only while this page is open. Nothing is sent otherwise. The Stop button on the map ends it, and a switch you turn off by hand stays off until you turn it on again. Off: sharing starts only when you switch it on.
Friends who are online see you on their map, marked as a friend. Off: only trip parties are included.

Uses your position to enable a Check in button on a marker when you are within 300 m of it. Your position is read only while the panel shows markers and is never sent anywhere. A check-in saves your coordinates and the time with the marker, in this browser.

Every marker shows its straight-line distance to your nearest Home. A waypoint also shows its nearest Home point and Accommodation, only from its own trip and only those whose dates overlap its own (one with no dates counts for every date). If a waypoint is farther than the max range from every such Home point and Accommodation, it is shown in red; your Home does not count toward the range. Units also set the map's scale bar. Elevation and height limits stay in metres.

A short log of problems (failed requests, errors) is kept in this browser only: at most 500 entries, 200 KB and 7 days. It holds no positions, marker names, notes, tokens or account details, and nothing is sent anywhere. Download it if someone is helping you with a problem.
the basemap you pick is loaded from OpenStreetMap, OpenStreetMap France (the Humanitarian and CyclOSM styles) or OpenTopoMap, which see which area you view.
online search sends your query to Photon or Nominatim, only when you search. Name lookup on import does the same with the names in the import, only if you turn it on above.
your position is read by the browser only while check-in is on and the panel shows markers. It is saved with the marker in this browser, included in an export, and left out of share links.

marker names and notes, your saved markers, the wind limit, and these settings. Your location is read by the browser when you press the location button and, unless you turn it off above, once when the app opens; it stays on this device.
